text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I haven't run `python3 -m unittest`. I have no shell tool in this session, so the suite is unverified. Please run it to confirm. I read the code and tests and checked each fix against its test by hand.

- **`books.py`**: `parse_book` now converts the year to an `int`.
- **`factory.py`**: `sample_books` now includes `Emma` (Austen, 1815, 1 copy), so it returns three books.
- **`fees.py`**: `late_fee` now multiplies days by `DAILY_FEE`. It was adding them.
- **`inventory.py`**: `recent(n)` was returning `n+1` events. It now returns the last `n`, and an empty list when `n <= 0`.
- **`members.py`**: `MAX_BORROWED` is now 5, matching the lending-policy comment and the tests.
- **`search.py`**: it now imports `normalize` from `catalog.text`. It was importing from a module that doesn't exist, which broke the whole module on import.

I didn't modify any tests.
